title: Prefixes 3
note: B2 WF unit, drafted 2026-09-05 on the home lane. House style cloned from b2_prefixes_1 / b2_suffixes_1. Scope per B2-PLAN, which already rescoped this node once because over-, under- and re- belong to b1_prefixes: en-/em- / de- / self- / semi- / multi- / out- / post- / fore-. EVERY CUE WAS SWEPT and the sweep changed the unit: `able` came back untaught, so ABLE -> enable was dropped and replaced (COLOUR -> multicoloured), and `rich`, `courage`, `final`, `circle`, `employed`, `cast` and `freeze` were all rejected as cues for the same reason — no item asks a student to derive from a word they have never met. The corrected pool also caught `multicultural`, which would have been the obvious multi- example: it was taught this morning by leaf_society_b2, whose node is still `coming`. Distractors are the unit's own axis (B6): the SAME stem carrying a WRONG prefix from this set or from b1_prefixes — unlarge, overlive, beforesee, aftergraduate, manytask, auto-control. Those are not invented nonsense, they are the calque a Czech speaker actually produces, translating the free word instead of reaching for the bound prefix (B4), and all six drive the Use stage. Use is error-correction (E7/E9), every prompt carrying one genuine wrong prefix.
use_hint: Fix the sentence · Enter = check · Enter = next

cards.title: Prefixes 3
points: Prefixes 1 built opposites; Prefixes 2 built relations.
This set **makes** things, **undoes** them, and places them in time.

cards.title: You already know
points: These place a word in **time** or turn it into an **action**.

rows: make it, undo it, before, after

cards.title: Make it and undo it
points: **en-** turns an adjective or noun into a verb.
**de-** takes the thing back off again.

cards.title: Yourself, half, many
points: *Auto-* does NOT do this job in English, although it looks like it should.

cards.title: More than, after, before
points: **out-** means beating or passing something, not doing it too much.
**post-** and **fore-** are the bound forms of *after* and *before*.

cards.title: Common mistakes
points: Czech translates the free word. English needs the bound prefix.

items.en: en- / em-
items.cz: udělat něco takovým · make it so

items.en: de-
self-
items.cz: sám sebe · by or to yourself

items.en: semi-
multi-
out-
items.cz: víc nebo déle než · more than, beyond

items.en: post-
fore-
Pollution can endanger the whole river.
accepts: Pollution can endanger the whole river.
items.explanation: **en-** makes a verb: *en* + danger = put in danger.

items.en: We must enlarge the photo for the wall.
items.cz: Tu fotku musíme na zeď zvětšit.
items.gap: We must ____ the photo for the wall. (LARGE)
accepts: We must enlarge the photo for the wall.
items.explanation: **en-** again: *en* + large = make large.

items.en: Please ensure the door is locked.
items.cz: Prosím zajisti, aby byly dveře zamčené.
accepts: Please ensure the door is locked.
items.explanation: **en-** + sure = make sure. Note the spelling: *ensure*, one word.
items.explanation_cz: **en-** + sure = ujistit se. Pozor na pravopis: *ensure*, jedno slovo.

items.en: Nobody could decode the old message.
items.cz: Tu starou zprávu nikdo nedokázal rozluštit.
accepts: Nobody could decode the old message.
items.explanation: **de-** undoes: *de* + code = take the code off.

items.en: A bad review can devalue the whole book.
items.cz: Špatná recenze může celou knihu znehodnotit.
items.gap: A bad review can ____ the whole book. (VALUE)
accepts: A bad review can devalue the whole book.
items.explanation: **de-** takes away: *de* + value = reduce the value.

items.en: He lost his self-control at the meeting.
items.gap: He lost his ____ at the meeting. (CONTROL)
accepts: He lost his self-control at the meeting.
items.explanation: **self-** points back at the person: control of yourself.
items.explanation_cz: **self-** ukazuje zpět na osobu: ovládání sebe sama.

items.en: The hotel has a self-service breakfast.
accepts: The hotel has a self-service breakfast.
items.explanation: **self-** again: you serve yourself.

items.en: They bought a semi-detached house.
accepts: They bought a semi-detached house.
items.explanation: **semi-** = half. The house is half joined to the next one.
items.explanation_cz: **semi-** = napůl. Dům je napůl spojený se sousedním.

items.en: Some people cannot multitask at all.
items.cz: Někteří lidé vůbec neumí dělat víc věcí najednou.
accepts: Some people can't multitask at all.
Some people cannot multitask at all.
items.explanation: **multi-** = many: doing many tasks at once.

items.en: The visitors outnumber the local people here.
items.gap: The visitors ____ the local people here. (NUMBER)
accepts: The visitors outnumber the local people here.
items.explanation: **out-** = more than: to be greater in number.

items.en: She started a postgraduate course in May.
items.gap: She started a ____ course in May. (GRADUATE)
accepts: She started a postgraduate course in May.
items.explanation: **post-** = after: after your first degree.

items.en: Nobody could foresee the crisis.
accepts: Nobody could foresee the crisis.
items.explanation: **fore-** = before: to see it coming.

items.en: Computers encode every message before sending.
items.cz: Počítače každou zprávu před odesláním zakódují.
accepts: Computers encode every message before sending.
items.explanation: **en-** puts it in: *en* + code = put into code. The opposite of *decode*.
items.explanation_cz: **en-** to vkládá: *en* + code = převést do kódu. Opak *decode*.

items.en: She sounded self-confident on the phone.
accepts: She sounded self-confident on the phone.
items.explanation: **self-** + confident = confident in yourself.

items.en: He is a self-taught musician.
accepts: He's a self-taught musician.
He is a self-taught musician.
He has a self-taught musician.
items.explanation: **self-** + taught = you taught yourself.

items.en: The shop has a big self-help section.
items.cz: Ten obchod má velké oddělení svépomoci.
items.gap: The shop has a big ____ section. (HELP)
accepts: The shop has a big self-help section.
items.explanation: **self-** + help = helping yourself.

items.en: The children wore multicoloured hats.
accepts: The children wore multicoloured hats.
items.explanation: **multi-** = many: many colours at once.

items.en: Children outgrow their shoes very fast.
items.cz: Děti velmi rychle vyrostou z bot.
accepts: Children outgrow their shoes very fast.
items.explanation: **out-** = beyond: to grow past the size of something.

items.en: She will probably outlive her brother.
accepts: She'll probably outlive her brother.
She will probably outlive her brother.
items.explanation: **out-** = longer than: to live longer than someone.
items.explanation_cz: **out-** = déle než: žít déle než někdo.

items.en: No dog can outrun that horse.
accepts: No dog can outrun that horse.
items.explanation: **out-** = faster or further than.

items.en: The small team outperform the big one.
items.cz: Ten malý tým překonává ten velký.
items.gap: The small team ____ the big one. (PERFORM)
accepts: The small team outperform the big one.
items.explanation: **out-** = better than: to perform better.

items.en: The postwar years were very hard.
accepts: The postwar years were very hard.
items.explanation: **post-** = after: the years after the war.

items.en: He put a cold cloth on his forehead.
items.cz: Dal si na čelo studený hadr.
items.gap: He put a cold cloth on his ____. (HEAD)
accepts: He put a cold cloth on his forehead.
items.explanation: **fore-** = front: the front of the head.

items.en: The child stands in the foreground of the picture.
items.cz: To dítě stojí v popředí obrazu.
items.gap: The child stands in the ____ of the picture. (GROUND)
accepts: The child stands in the foreground of the picture.
items.explanation: **fore-** = in front: the front part of a picture.

items.en: We must enlarge the photo for the wall.
items.cz: Tu fotku musíme na zeď zvětšit.
items.wrong: We must unlarge the photo for the wall.
accepts: We must enlarge the photo for the wall.
items.explanation: *Un-* makes an opposite. To MAKE something large you need **en-**: *enlarge*.
items.explanation_cz: *Un-* dělá opak. Když chceš něco zvětšit, potřebuješ **en-**: *enlarge*.

items.en: She will probably outlive her brother.
items.wrong: She will probably overlive her brother.
accepts: She'll probably outlive her brother.
She will probably outlive her brother.
items.explanation: *Over-* is too much of something. Longer than someone else is **out-**: *outlive*.
items.explanation_cz: *Over-* je příliš mnoho. Déle než někdo jiný je **out-**: *outlive*.

items.en: Nobody could foresee the crisis.
accepts: Nobody could foresee the crisis.
items.explanation: *Before* is a word, not a prefix here. The prefix is **fore-**: *foresee*.
items.explanation_cz: *Before* je slovo, ne předpona. Předpona je **fore-**: *foresee*.

items.en: She started a postgraduate course in May.
items.wrong: She started an aftergraduate course in May.
accepts: She started a postgraduate course in May.
items.explanation: *After* is a word. The prefix meaning after is **post-**: *postgraduate*.
items.explanation_cz: *After* je slovo. Předpona pro po je **post-**: *postgraduate*.

items.en: Some people cannot multitask at all.
items.cz: Někteří lidé vůbec neumí dělat víc věcí najednou.
items.wrong: Some people cannot manytask at all.
accepts: Some people can't multitask at all.
Some people cannot multitask at all.
items.explanation: *Many* is a word. The prefix meaning many is **multi-**: *multitask*.
items.explanation_cz: *Many* je slovo. Předpona pro mnoho je **multi-**: *multitask*.

items.en: He lost his self-control at the meeting.
items.wrong: He lost his auto-control at the meeting.
accepts: He lost his self-control at the meeting.
items.explanation: *Auto-* is not this prefix in English. Control of yourself is **self-control**.
items.explanation_cz: *Auto-* tady v angličtině není. Ovládání sebe je **self-control**.
